subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway 40B Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board reviewed final peer review comments and discussed the requested waiver list for a proposed 350-unit residential development at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway. The board made a specific finding regarding the calculation of linkage fee exemptions and continued the matter for final conditions drafting.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway, Case Number 40B-2022-01
items.summary: The board resumed consideration of a petition for a comprehensive permit to build an eight-story, 350-unit rental development with 25% affordable housing units.

items.title: Engineering Peer Review
items.summary: Sean Reardon of Tetra Tech presented final recommendations regarding construction management, site lighting, pedestrian safety bollards, and lane alignment for the project.

items.title: Architectural Peer Review
items.summary: Cliff Boehmer provided recommendations for active play spaces in the courtyard, facade maintenance warranties, flexibility for expanded bike storage, and solar energy requirement compliance.

items.title: Phased Occupancy and Fire Safety Update
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte reported that a plan for fire-rated assemblies and full system activation has been established to allow partial occupancy while construction continues.

items.title: Linkage Fee Finding
items.summary: The board voted that, in the absence of a waiver, 25% of the units plus the commercial space would be exempt from city linkage fees based on their affordable status.

items.title: Waiver List Refinement and Continuation
items.summary: The board directed the applicant to provide a more specific waiver list and continued the hearing to June 5, 2023, to review drafted conditions.
